title: Article 16 Article 16  A person subject to a decision for commencement of assistance becomes a person under assistance, and an assistant is appointed for that person.
statute_text:
Article 16 Article 16  A person subject to a decision for commencement of assistance becomes a person under assistance, and an assistant is appointed for that person.
(Decisions Requiring Person to Obtain Consent of Assistant)
